reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 7 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bucks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bucks (revenge, streak).
Bottom line: the Raptors win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 199 and 247 total points.
